verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no documented machine interface that an external agent could use to build or update a forecast or scenario. AI Modeler is an in-product natural-language feature, and the Excel connector is a push/pull spreadsheet tool for humans, so both are adjacent features rather than an agent API. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404. Edit-history auditing is documented, but nothing shows machine-driven changes landing in that same trail.
